name: com.newswithoutpictures/news
title: News Without Pictures
description: Verified news from three papers: News, Tech, NCAA Football. No key. Call list_papers first.

tools.name: get_latest_edition
tools.description: The latest edition of News Without Pictures: the eight most important verified news stories right now, each in two paragraphs with sources. Published at 7 a.m. and 5 p.m. New York time. Use this to answer 'what's in the news today?' Pass format 'headlines' for a short answer (each headline, its first sentence and link; about a fifth the length). Pass paper 'tech' or 'ncaa' for the Tech or NCAA Football paper.

format.description: 'full' (default): every story in full with sources. 'headlines': headline, first sentence and link for each story.

paper.description: 'news' (default): the main paper. 'tech': Tech Without Pictures (AI and the companies building it). 'ncaa': NCAA Football Without Pictures (the Top 25 and the playoff race).

tools.name: list_papers
tools.description: The News Without Pictures papers: the main paper (news), Tech Without Pictures (tech) and NCAA Football Without Pictures (ncaa). For each: its latest edition id and lead headline, when the next edition comes out, and its web, markdown, RSS and email-signup links. Pass the paper id to get_latest_edition.

tools.name: get_story
tools.description: One News Without Pictures story in full by its slug (from get_latest_edition, search_stories or a story URL), with every source linked and any corrections.

slug.description: The story slug, from an edition or a story URL.

tools.name: list_editions
tools.description: Recent editions (id, name, publication time), newest first. Pass paper (news, tech or ncaa) for a section paper's editions; default news.

tools.name: get_edition
tools.description: A past edition by id, for example 2026-11-24-morning, or a section paper's, for example tech-2026-11-26-morning (ids from list_editions).

tools.name: search_stories
tools.description: Search published stories by keywords or a plain question, e.g. 'Ukraine peace talks'. Returns each matching headline with its date, first sentence, slug and link, newest first; call get_story for the full story.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: Catch up on a developing story: where it stands, the next date to watch, and every News Without Pictures story on it, newest first. Call with no slug to list the topics.

slug.description: Topic slug, e.g. medicare-disaster-lists. Omit to list topics.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search News Without Pictures stories by keywords or a plain question (stories with every word first, then the closest matches). An empty query returns the latest edition's stories. Returns JSON {results:[{id,title,url}]}; pass an id to fetch for the full story.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one News Without Pictures story by id (its slug, from search). Returns JSON {id,title,text,url,metadata} with sources and corrections.
